callouts.text: Heading 'Distance to retina' -> 'Estimated clearance': the number is a model estimate, not a measurement of the retina
Two decimals (1.58) -> one decimal, rounded down; 0.01 mm steps were 60x finer than the median height error
'Approaching retina' -> 'Near retina': the level encodes proximity only; motion is reported separately (8)
Persistent qualifier (simulation here). Live notes condition on the DISPLAYED level: Critical 1–5.6 mm, Near 1.6–3.4 mm (p10–p90 midpoint truth); Clear ≈0.6 mm too close.
Nearest tip L / R / L ≈ R: tie band plus 500 ms dwell stabilise Q2; the number still shows the instantaneous minimum.
Per-tip values: one decimal, colour per tip level (bars unchanged)
Trend: labelled 0.5 / 2 mm boundaries and time axis. Whole history uses current level colour; bands locate historical values in threshold zones.
Contact countdown removed from computation and display; motion word + rate (1 decimal) kept
Instrument state: jaws as word (mm as note), insertion in whole mm
